description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerAttributeService for managing customer attributes in the system. It extends a generic service class and interacts with a Data Access Object (DAO) to perform CRUD operations related to customer attributes, including saving, updating, deleting, and retrieving attributes based on various criteria.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class managing customer attributes, extending a generic entity service, providing methods for saving, updating, deleting, and retrieving customer attribute data.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new customer attribute or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer attribute after re-fetching it to ensure it's attached to the session.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a customer attribute based on store, customer ID, and option ID.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer attributes associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves customer attributes by option value ID within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves customer attributes by option ID within a store.
